chunks: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"The Ka'bah was named Ka'bah because it is the center of the world."

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةُ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.كَعْبَةً: Ka'bah as the specific name being explained

ai.seo_question: Why was the Ka'bah named Ka'bah according to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله؟
ai.summary: This hadith attributes the naming of the Ka'bah to its being the center of the world. It highlights the Ka'bah's unique cosmological and sacred centrality within the Islamic understanding of hajj and worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2109 - The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"The Ka'bah was named 'Ka'bah' because it is the center of the world."
